name: progress
title: Progress
summary: Determinate progress. Two shapes: ProgressBar (linear, four tones) + ProgressRing (circular, Lumen-signature for hero KPI tiles). Bar honors three sizes (sm h1 / md h1.5 / lg h2). Ring uses stroke-dasharray + dashoffset with cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1) 280ms transition.
description: Token-driven determinate progress — bar + Lumen-signature ring.
skillDescription: Use ProgressBar for linear determinate (form completion, file upload). Use ProgressRing for hero KPI tiles where the donut IS the metric (capacity, on-time %, savings goal). Four tones: accent / success / warning / danger / neutral. For indeterminate use Spinner.
useWhen: Determinate linear progress (form completion, file upload).
Hero KPI tile where the donut IS the metric (capacity, OTD %, goal).
anatomy: ProgressBar — track + indicator + optional label + value display
ProgressRing — SVG circle base + circle fill (stroke-dasharray animated)
Center value display (heading-h6 ratio, --type-22 on size 56 ring)
never: NEVER use Progress for indeterminate — use Spinner.
a11yRules: ProgressRing — role=img + aria-label with the value or label.
do: Pair color tone with semantic meaning.
